blueprintCheck.document: CalcuMint Final Master Blueprint & Product Architecture 2026
rules: One authoritative deterministic engine and equal accuracy across Free/Pro/Business
Catalog is planning inventory; no automatic public publication
Certified repository definitions are mathematical authority
DRAFT -> Review -> Certified -> Published Final; no mass promotion
Immutable technical revisions and historical outputs preserved
blueprintCheck.limits: Owner product-scope selection is not proof of formula/source/domain certification; exact engine contracts and specialist requirements must still be verified.

selected.title: Vacancy Impact Calculator
selected.selectedFormula: Lost gross rent = supplied potential gross rent × supplied vacancy fraction; compare supplied vacancy scenarios.
selected.selectedDomainPolicy: Same rent period/currency; no NOI or net-profit impact without itemized avoidable costs.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Cost of Living Comparison Calculator
selected.selectedFormula: Compare totals of two explicit, like-for-like expense baskets; optionally show percentage difference against a positive base total.
selected.selectedDomainPolicy: Same currency and time period, user-supplied category amounts; no city dataset, CPI or purchasing-power claim.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Revenue Calculator
selected.selectedFormula: Sum explicitly supplied sales lines (price × quantity) in one currency/period.
selected.selectedDomainPolicy: Gross modeled sales only unless a qualified accounting recognition policy is supplied.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Project Profitability Calculator
selected.selectedFormula: Report separately declared project revenue minus costs, margin and/or dated NPV under an explicit selected metric.
selected.selectedDomainPolicy: No silently chosen profit/ROI/NPV identity; costs and cash-flow periods supplied.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Freelancer Hourly Rate Calculator
selected.selectedFormula: Required hourly revenue = supplied annual revenue target / positive supplied billable hours.
selected.selectedDomainPolicy: Target and billable capacity supplied; no invented tax gross-up, utilization or labor entitlement.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Agency Pricing Calculator

selected.title: Discount Impact Calculator

selected.selectedDomainPolicy: Volumes supplied separately; no assumed demand elasticity or automatic volume uplift.
selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Price Increase Impact Calculator

selected.nextAction: Verify exact selected contract against governing Blueprint and engine; implement only demonstrated gaps; retain specialist and publication gates.

selected.title: Unit Economics Calculator

selected.title: Rule of 40 Calculator

selected.title: Subscription Pricing Calculator
